orientation.basis: The prominent title, body, lower label, and 2+ marker have level horizontal baselines and read left-to-right. The luminous background display is oblique in scene perspective but does not require rotating the full image.

blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame filled with dense dark blue, black, magenta, and red structural textures, including numerous looping cables and angular panel-like forms.

A large tilted luminous rectangle occupies the upper-middle region. It grades from cyan-blue on the left to pink-red on the right and contains roughly nine rows of tiny oblique white alphanumeric marks arranged in several columns.
White starburst fractures and dark red splatter-like marks cross the luminous rectangle. Additional red-orange illumination enters from the right side.
A dark near-square object with strongly rounded corners and a thick pale border is centered below the luminous rectangle. Its interior is nearly black and contains extremely faint gray marks.
Immediately below the dark square is a compact blue-white composite glyph followed by 2+. Both sit above the main title plaque.

The lower region contains a wide near-black title plaque overlapping a larger translucent dark body panel. Thin bronze-orange outlines, stepped corners, projecting side tabs, and mirrored diagonal accents define the frame.
The title is one centered uppercase line. The body consists of two centered lines, and a centered orange uppercase label appears near the panel bottom.

The orange diagonal side marks are physically integrated into the frame. Background cracks, splatter, cables, and illuminated equipment retain irregular pictorial texture rather than clean isolated symbol boundaries.
